column1: # A second held-out draw: 300 random PubChem molecules, `group name SMILES`.
# Seed 20261002, disjoint from all 7255 molecules in every corpus used for a
# decision before it, including `embed_corpus_heldout.tsv`. Drawn because the
# curated 72 and the PubChem 287 disagreed about the 1-3 ring angles and the
# 1-4 ceiling -- curated 0.06 kcal/mol for, PubChem 0.22 against -- and both
# had been read too often that week to arbitrate anything.
# Spent on 2026-10-02 deciding that question (baseline 163 of 292 at +1.73,
# the change 167 at +1.17). It is tuning data now. Draw a third with a new
# seed if another tie needs breaking.
